empty.text: The bot answers customers only from knowledge base documents. Upload the first Markdown file or add the text manually.

toggle.offStep1: The document stops taking part in the bot's search: for questions about it the bot will say "I don't know" or use another document.
toggle.offStep2: The file and fragments are not deleted — you can enable the document again.
toggle.onStep1: The document takes part in the bot's search again.
toggle.onStep2: The fragments are already built, no re-indexing is needed.
toggle.step3: The change is written to the CRM audit log: who and when.

reingest.step1: The document joins the indexing queue — status "Queued".
reingest.step2: The fragments are rebuilt from the saved file; it takes up to a minute.
reingest.step3: If the document is being indexed right now, CRM refuses: wait and try again.

chunks.title: Fragments
chunks.hint: This is how the bot's search sees the document: the bot answers from these pieces of text.
chunks.empty: No fragments yet: the document has not been indexed.

upload.title: Upload a Markdown file
upload.fileHint: One .md file in the knowledge base format, up to 25 MB.

manual.title: Add a document manually
manual.textHint: You can skip the first-level heading: it is taken from the title.

create.step1: The document joins the indexing queue — status "Queued".
create.step1Gap: The document joins the indexing queue, and the gap it was created from is closed.
create.step2: In a minute the bot starts answering from the new document; check it in "What the bot will find".
create.step3: The upload is written to the CRM audit log: who and when.
create.done: Document added — indexing takes up to a minute
create.doneGap: Document added, gap closed — indexing takes up to a minute

errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than 25 MB.

format.title: How to prepare the file
format.intro: The file is prepared by a person or an AI assistant outside the system; here it is only checked and split into fragments.
rules: At the start — a front matter block between --- lines: title, language (ru, uz or en), source (where the document comes from), updated (YYYY-MM-DD); optional tags and audience.
One document — one topic. One "# …" heading, then "##" and "###" sections: the bot splits the text into fragments by them.
Tables in GFM format, whole. No images or links to files: describe the image in words.
No customers' personal data or internal cost prices. Up to 100 KB, UTF-8 encoding.

gaps.title: Knowledge base gaps
gaps.hint: Customer questions the bot found no answer to. The most frequently asked are on top.
gaps.caption: Knowledge base gaps
gaps.tableScroll: Knowledge base gaps: the table can be scrolled

open.title: No open gaps
open.text: Questions the bot found no answer to appear here — close them with a new document.

resolved.title: No closed gaps
resolved.text: A gap is closed by a document: create it from the question or link an existing one.

ignored.title: No ignored gaps
ignored.text: Questions that need no answer, such as jokes, end up here.

gapPanel.notFound: The gap is not in this list: it may have been closed already.
gapPanel.stepAudit: The change is written to the CRM audit log: who and when.

create.button: Create a document from the question

link.step1: The gap is closed: the answer to the question is already in the chosen document.
link.step2: The document itself does not change — if the answer is not there, add it before closing.
link.step3: A closed gap can be returned to the open ones.

ignore.step1: The question leaves the open gaps.
ignore.step2: The bot answers it as before; you can return the question on the "Ignored" tab.

reopen.step1: The question appears among the open gaps again.
reopen.step2: If the gap was closed by a document, the link to it is removed.

sandbox.title: Bot sandbox
sandbox.intro: Write to the bot as a customer: the reply goes the same way as in Telegram — knowledge base, texts, handoff rules. Customers and managers do not see this conversation.
sandbox.paid: Paid: replies are counted in "Spend" as a test.
sandbox.handoffNote: Handoff to a manager is only shown below: it is not sent to the team channel or CRM.
sandbox.empty: Ask a question customers often ask — for example, about delivery time or warranty.
sandbox.step1: The message goes to the bot on behalf of a test customer: the bot answers from the knowledge base, texts and handoff rules.
sandbox.step2: The reply is paid: model calls go to "Spend" marked "test".
sandbox.step3: Handoff to a manager is only shown below; no handoff is created in CRM.

reset.step1: The test conversation is deleted completely — customers and managers do not have it.
reset.step2: The thread on the screen is cleared and the bot starts from scratch.
reset.step3: The action is written to the CRM audit log: who and when.
